knownGaps: Historical retrospective coverage (archiveDate-tagged entries) is now CONTINUOUS across all 18 months from July 2024 through December 2025, no monthly gaps remain in that window. All of 2026 has not been retrospectively researched at all, that is the entire remaining scope for 'complete the historical archive.'

Food Systems & Community Health and Waste & Circular Materials are the thinnest categories (4 entries each) against their ~4-6/year directional targets. Energy is now the heaviest at 10, mostly because several genuinely distinct, well-sourced Energy stories existed in the same months, this was not forced, but future batches should lean toward other categories where the evidence supports it.

The 2025-12 energy-storage entry uses only ACP/Wood Mackenzie's figures (18.9 GW, 52%); a competing SEIA/Benchmark Mineral Intelligence report gave different figures (57.6 GWh, 30%) for what may be a different scope. Do not blend the two reports' numbers in a future piece without resolving why they diverge.

A prior version of this file and CLAUDE.md incorrectly claimed 'all of July-December 2024' was covered before August 2024 actually had an entry, that was a real documentation error, now corrected. Always verify claimed coverage against an actual query of lib/fieldNotes.ts (e.g. archiveDate distinct values), don't just trust the running narrative.
